title: Bounds for the odd-level tail
statement: If $k$ is an odd natural number, the limiting majority Fourier weight above $k$ lies in the closed interval with endpoints $M(k)(1-1/k)$ and $M(k)(1+1/(3k))$, where $M(k)=(2/\pi)^{3/2}k^{-1/2}$.
